stories.title: Build IT Level 4-5 Knowledge Assessment Suite with System Administration Focus
stories.description: Create dual-level knowledge assessments for IT Levels 4 and 5 covering advanced system administration, network security, infrastructure optimization, IT service management per NOSS IT-020-4:2013 and IT-020-5:2013 CoCU.
acceptanceCriteria: Create it-computer-system/C03-Level4/KA.md with 40 mixed-format questions (MCQ, short-answer rubrics, scenario analysis) covering network administration, security hardening, performance tuning
Create it-computer-system/C04-Level5/KA.md with 40 strategic-level questions covering IT service management, business continuity, system architecture, governance decisions
Generate cross-reference index mapping each question to specific Related Knowledge items in respective CoCU
technicalNotes: File to create: it-computer-system/C03-Level4/KA.md (mixed question formats with answer scheme)
File to create: it-computer-system/C04-Level5/KA.md (strategic scenario questions with rubrics)

stories.title: Build NOSS CoCU Related Knowledge Coverage Validator for BEV C01-C05
stories.description: Automated validation tool that scans BEV NOSS CoCU extract, maps all Related Knowledge items to corresponding KP files, reports coverage gaps, and generates per-CU coverage metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Script reads BEV NOSS CoCU data (from 00-noss-extract.md or parsed PDF), extracts all RK items per CU, cross-references against KP files
Generate report showing: (a) RK items with 100% KP coverage, (b) RK items with partial coverage, (c) RK items with zero coverage, (d) KP content orphaned from any RK
Output metrics file with per-CU coverage %, overall coverage %, and prioritized gap list
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/validators/rk_coverage_validator.py (parser for NOSS extract, KP matcher, report generator)
File to create: _reference/bev-rk-coverage-report.json (output metrics)
Test command: uv run python _tools/validators/rk_coverage_validator.py bev --output json --all-cu
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Create BEV KK Work Activity Step Numbering and Format Validator
stories.description: Validation tool ensuring all BEV KK files use consistent LANGKAH KERJA table format with properly numbered steps, prerequisite knowledge checks, safety/hazard identification, and checkpoints per Buku Panduan WIM standards.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator checks each KK file for: (a) LANGKAH KERJA table present with proper header, (b) sequential step numbering with no gaps/duplicates, (c) each step has columns: Step#, Action, Safety/Hazard, Checkpoint, Expected Result, (d) final step includes return-to-normal-state procedure
Flags format violations and generates per-file compliance report for all BEV C01-C05 KK files
Provide template snippet output showing correct LANGKAH KERJA format for non-compliant files
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/validators/kk_step_format_validator.py (markdown table parser, format checker, template generator)
File to create: _reference/kk-format-compliance-report.txt (output report)
Test command: uv run python _tools/validators/kk_step_format_validator.py bev-diagnostic-rectification --format txt

stories.title: Build Multi-Subject Bilingual Terminology Index Generator with Consistency Checker
stories.description: Automated tool scanning all KP, KT, KK, KA, PA files across BEV, Aesthetic, IT subjects, extracting and indexing bilingual terminology pairs, flagging inconsistencies, and generating searchable reference.

stories.title: Build IT Knowledge Sheets Structure Analyzer Against WIM Buku Panduan Standards
stories.description: Validation tool auditing all IT KP files for compliance with JPK Buku Panduan WIM Edisi 2020 structure: required sections (TAJUK, TUJUAN, PENGENALAN, PENERANGAN with subsections, RUMUSAN), formatting, bilingual notation.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator checks IT KP files for: (a) TAJUK present with correct code format [NOSS]-[CU]/[DocCode], (b) TUJUAN as numbered learning objectives (1-5 items), (c) PENGENALAN section (background/intro), (d) PENERANGAN main content with ≥2 logical subsections, (e) RUMUSAN (summary paragraph)
Generate compliance report showing % of IT KP files meeting standard, list violations by type and severity
Suggest structure corrections for non-compliant files with template section alignment

stories.title: Build BEV KK Prerequisite Knowledge Mapper to KP Coverage Matrix
stories.description: Tool analyzing each BEV work activity (KK), identifying prerequisite Related Knowledge needed to perform the activity, cross-referencing to KP coverage, and generating alignment matrix showing KK→RK→KP relationships.
acceptanceCriteria: Analyze BEV KK files, extract work steps, identify RK prerequisites required to safely/correctly perform each activity (e.g., KK-01 'Disconnect HV Battery' requires understanding HV safety from KP-01, BMS components from KP-02)

Generate _reference/bev-kk-to-kp-mapping.md showing per-KK: (a) work activity title, (b) prerequisite RK items, (c) corresponding KP files covering those RK, (d) coverage status (Complete/Partial/Gap)
Ensure all prerequisites for each KK are covered by KP in same or earlier CU; flag gaps where RK has no supporting KP
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/validators/kk_prerequisite_mapper.py (KK parser, RK extractor, KP matcher)
File to create: _reference/bev-kk-to-kp-mapping.md (prerequisite matrix table)
Test command: uv run python _tools/validators/kk_prerequisite_mapper.py bev && grep -c '^- Gap:' _reference/bev-kk-to-kp-mapping.md (should be 0)

stories.title: Create Aesthetic KP-to-Knowledge Assessment Alignment Validator with Objective Coverage Analysis
stories.description: Automated tool validating that every learning objective in Aesthetic KP (TUJUAN section) is tested by corresponding KA questions with appropriate cognitive complexity, generates coverage matrix, flags under-tested objectives.
acceptanceCriteria: Parser extracts TUJUAN (numbered learning objectives 1-5) from each Aesthetic KP file, identifies corresponding KA file (same CU), cross-references questions to objectives using keyword matching

Validator checks: (a) each objective has ≥2 assessment questions, (b) question cognitive type matches objective complexity (recall objectives tested with direct/MCQ, analysis objectives with scenario/application questions), (c) no KA question is orphaned (all questions map to at least one KP objective)
Generate report showing per-objective coverage %, flags any objective with <2 questions, generates list of under-tested objectives prioritized for KA expansion
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/validators/kp_ka_alignment_validator.py (objective extractor, question-to-objective matcher, coverage analyzer)
File to create: _reference/aesthetic-kp-ka-alignment-report.md (per-CU coverage matrix)
Test command: uv run python _tools/validators/kp_ka_alignment_validator.py aesthetic-services && grep 'Coverage:' _reference/aesthetic-kp-ka-alignment-report.md
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 0 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds

stories.title: Create IT C01-C05 Practical Procedures with Step-by-Step Safety Checkpoints
stories.description: Develop comprehensive KK work activity procedures for IT Levels 3, 4, 5 covering hands-on labs: server/client setup, network configuration, security hardening, backup/recovery, troubleshooting with detailed LANGKAH KERJA tables and safety/error prevention checkpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Create 8-10 KK files: C01-KK-01 (Server OS Installation), C02-KK-01 (Network Configuration), C03-KK-01 (Security Hardening), C04-KK-01 (Backup Procedures), C05-KK-01 (Incident Response/Troubleshooting). Each with LANGKAH KERJA table: Step#, Action, Safety/Hazard, Checkpoint, Expected Result columns
Each procedure cross-references prerequisite knowledge to corresponding KP file sections (e.g., 'Requires KP-01 understanding of Windows Server roles')
Include 3-5 safety/error prevention checkpoints per procedure (e.g., 'Verify firewall rules configured correctly before connecting to production network')

Test command: uv run python _tools/validators/kk_step_format_validator.py it-computer-system --verbose (check all 5 files have proper LANGKAH KERJA tables)

stories.title: Create BEV-Aesthetic Shared Terminology Conflict Resolver with Subject-Specific Usage Guide
stories.description: Tool identifying EN/BM terms used in both BEV and Aesthetic but with different meanings or technical contexts, documents conflicts with usage recommendations, and generates style guide for terminology consistency per subject.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare EN/BM terminology extracted from BEV and Aesthetic bilingual indices, identify overlaps where term meaning differs significantly by subject (e.g., 'battery' in BEV as power source vs skincare battery terminology, 'client' in BEV diagnostics context vs Aesthetic client consultation)

Generate _reference/terminology-conflicts.md documenting: (a) conflicting term, (b) EN definition/context in BEV, (c) EN definition/context in Aesthetic, (d) recommended usage notation with subject labels, (e) example sentences from each subject showing distinct usage
Provide validation command template to check new content for terminology conflicts with context-sensitive resolution hints
technicalNotes: File to create: _tools/resolvers/terminology_conflict_resolver.py (bilingual index comparator, conflict detector, usage guide generator)
File to create: _reference/terminology-conflicts.md (conflict documentation with usage recommendations)
Test command: uv run python _tools/resolvers/terminology_conflict_resolver.py bev aesthetic && grep -c '^##' _reference/terminology-conflicts.md (should find 5-10 key conflicts)
